title: Accessibility Totem
description: A resourcepack that change Minecraft totem to accessibility icon
body:
**Accessibility Totem** is a simple resource pack that replaces Minecraft’s totem of undying with an accessibility‑style icon.

**This pack is purely cosmetic:** it only changes the totem’s textures and does not modify gameplay, stats, or sounds. It is mainly meant to be fun.

**License / Permissions：**

•All textures in this pack are my own edits of vanilla Minecraft assets.

•Do not re-upload this pack to other sites.

•You can use this pack in your own videos or modpacks. A credit link to this Modrinth page is not required, but it is appreciated.
